fields.name: Port Louis Street Food & Culinary Walk
fields.description: Taste your way through Port Louis' bustling streets with a local foodie guide, sampling beloved multicultural snacks and refreshing drinks.
fields.long_description: A guided walking tour through the capital city to sample iconic Mauritian street foods like dholl puri, gâteaux piments, and alouda, offering a firsthand taste of the island's diverse culinary identity which forms part of its richly diverse culture.

fields.name: Traditional Sega Dance & Music Experience
fields.description: Feel the heartbeat of Mauritius as performers play traditional acoustic instruments and dance to soulful Creole rhythms by the ocean.
fields.long_description: An immersive cultural experience celebrating UNESCO-recognized Sega music and dance, featuring traditional rhythms beaten on goat-skin ravanne drums around evening beach circles.

fields.name: Chinatown Street Art & Culture Tour
fields.description: Stroll through vibrant murals, historic herbal shops, and family-run bakeries that highlight the deep-rooted Chinese community culture in the capital.
fields.long_description: A vibrant neighborhood exploration featuring colorful mural-filled alleys, traditional Chinese grocery stores, herbal tea houses, and bustling local storefronts.

fields.name: Flacq Open-Air Market (Marché de Flacq)
fields.description: Immerse yourself in the colorful stalls of the island’s largest open-air market, where locals trade fresh fruits, spices, and textiles.
fields.long_description: The island's largest outdoor market, offering a deep, sensory dive into everyday local life, tropical produce piles, traditional fabrics, and vibrant community interactions.

fields.name: Sagar Shiv Mandir
fields.location: Île aux Bananes, Poste de Flacq
fields.description: Visit a tranquil temple situated on a small coastal islet, offering peaceful views and a serene glimpse into local Hindu traditions.
fields.long_description: An active, offshore spiritual sanctuary linked to the mainland by a narrow footbridge, showcasing peaceful Hindu worship traditions in a stunning coastal setting.

fields.name: Port Louis Central Market
fields.description: Explore the sights, sounds, and aromas of a legendary market filled with bustling merchant stalls and local chatter.
fields.long_description: A historic and bustlin market hub where locals gather daily to trade exotic spices, medicinal herbs, fresh seafood, and handcrafted goods.

fields.name: Mahebourg Waterfront & Fish Market Culture Location: Mahebourg
fields.description: Watch local fishermen unload their daily catch along a breezy southern waterfront filled with authentic village charm.
fields.long_description: A scenic coastal walk through a traditional fishing village, observing wooden pirogues, seaside community routines, and the lively local fish market.

fields.name: Caudan Arts Centre
fields.description: Experience contemporary Mauritian arts, live music, and theatrical performances at a modern waterfront cultural venue.
fields.long_description: A contemporary cultural hub for Mauritian performing arts, hosting live theater productions, traditional music showcases, dance recitals, and art exhibitions.

fields.name: Crafts Market at Le Caudan Waterfront
fields.description: Browse stalls filled with handmade souvenirs, woven crafts, and local artwork created by talented island artisans.
fields.long_description: A lively indoor bazaar dedicated to island craftsmanship, featuring hand-woven vacoas bags, local wood carvings, spices, and artisanal essential oils.

fields.name: Tamil Surya Oodaya Kouldon Temple
fields.description: Admire the striking colors and intricate religious architecture of a vibrant community temple in the north.
fields.long_description: A vibrant Dravidian-style temple showcasing living Tamil religious artistry, intricate Gopuram sculptures, and active community devotion.

fields.name: L'Aventure du Sucre Sugar & Rum Tasting
fields.description: Sample unique unrefined cane sugars and artisanal agricultural rums in a lively sensory tasting experience.
fields.long_description: A sensory tasting experience focusing on unrefined local cane sugars, artisanal honeys, and agricultural rums crafted on the island.

fields.name: Grand Baie Waterfront & Sunset Evening Stroll
fields.description: Enjoy coastal evening sunset views, budget street-food snacks like chili cakes or dholl puri, and casual shopping along the vibrant northern shoreline.
fields.long_description: A relaxed evening coastal walk along Grand Baie’s bay to enjoy the sunset, take in the lively nightlife ambiance along Royal Road, and sample cheap local street snacks from nearby seaside stalls.

fields.name: Cap Malheureux Coastal Village Life
fields.description: Experience quiet coastal village routines by watching local fishermen bring in their daily catches along the northern shore.
fields.long_description: An authentic look into quintessential northern coast lifestyle, watching local fishermen return with their daily catch against the backdrop of the iconic coastal chapel.
